one_liner: Zoho Cliq provides enterprise team messaging, chat, and collaboration tools via REST APIs and webhooks.
auth_notes: Zoho's OAuth implementation uses the Bearer authentication scheme with prefix 'Zoho-oauthtoken'. API tokens are also provided while creating an application with integration components.
verdict_reason: Zoho Cliq offers fully documented REST APIs with standard OAuth2 authentication and self-serve developer access via the Zoho API console.

evidence.quote: Zoho's OAuth implementation uses the Bearer authentication scheme; hence, when making API calls, the access token must be passed in the Authorization header with the prefix "Zoho-oauthtoken".
The first step in using OAuth authentication is registering your app with the Zoho API console. Once you register your client, you will get a Client ID and Client secret for your application.
Zoho Cliq API is organized around REST, and follows HTTP rules. Cliq REST APIs are authenticated with an OAuth token.
